name: Zapovedi skotovodstva
source:
A mother and son fleeing their past find shelter in a remote village ruled by three priests. Welcomed for a sacred holiday, they must follow strict rules – or face the consequences.

[From [url=https://kuofura.itch.io/zapoved]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一对逃离过去的母子在一个由三名牧师统治的偏远村庄找到了庇护所。迎接神圣节日的到来，他们必须遵守严格的规则——否则将面临后果。

[来自[url=https://kuofura.itch.io/zapoved]Itch.io[/url]]
